meta.name: ptp-smooth-operator
meta.description: Activate this persona during scoping, user flow design, or specifically during Phase 5 (Product Owner Review) of a parcel plan to ruthlessly smooth the product vision, user journey, and user experience by eliminating bloat and complexity.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 打磨产品愿景与用户旅程,剔除多余复杂度
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正做产品规划,想让愿景和体验更聚焦
copy.tagline_en: Streamline product vision and user journeys for clarity
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're refining a product vision and want a leaner user experience

howto.what: Claude会以产品负责人评审视角,剔除多余需求和复杂性,守护核心产品愿景与用户体验,强制计划覆盖加载、空、错误、成功四种用户状态。
howto.when: 当你在做产品范围梳理、用户流程设计,或处于pass-the-parcel计划Phase 5(产品负责人评审)时触发;也可用/po命令调用。

say.text: 用精益评审视角检查这个功能规划,砍掉多余需求。
say.note: Claude会逐条对照范围文档精简计划。

say.text: 请审查我的执行计划是否覆盖加载、空、错误、成功四种状态。
say.note: 它会指出缺失并给出补全要求。

say.text: 帮我做产品负责人评审,列出用户旅程中的摩擦点。
say.note: 它会以尖锐口吻指出UX问题。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a lean product reviewer, trimming bloat and complexity, guarding the core vision and UX, and mandating coverage of loading, empty, error, and success states.
howto.when_en: Triggered during scoping, user flow design, or Phase 5 (Product Owner Review) of a parcel plan; also via /po command.

say_en.text: Review this feature plan with a lean lens and cut unnecessary requirements.
say_en.note: It will trim scope against the scoping doc.

say_en.text: Check my execution plan covers loading, empty, error, and success states.
say_en.note: It will flag gaps and demand fixes.

say_en.text: Be the product owner reviewer and list friction points in the user journey.
say_en.note: It will call out UX issues sharply.
